skus.name: Alliance Tier
skus.description: For a growing alliance: 250 screenshots a week, 3 tracked channels, half a year of history and the full set of player reports.

benefits.name: 250 screenshots a week
benefits.description: Read up to 250 screenshots a week into your rosters, with zip and bulk uploads and priority in the reading queue.

benefits.name: 3 tracked channels
benefits.description: Keep separate datasets in up to 3 channels, one for each event or competition you track.

benefits.name: 26 weeks of history
benefits.description: Reports reach back half a year. Older weeks are never deleted, only hidden, and come back if you upgrade.

benefits.name: Player, trend and growth reports
benefits.description: Follow each player's progress week to week with /report player, /report trend and /report growth.

benefits.name: Clean charts, name tools and export
benefits.description: Charts without the Free-plan credit, duplicate-name and rename tools, and CSV/JSON export of your data.

benefits.name: A larger trivia bank
benefits.description: The standard trivia bank on top of the Last Z questions.

skus.name: Command Tier
skus.description: For alliances that track everything: 1,000 screenshots a week, unlimited channels and history, server-wide reports and the top queue spot.

benefits.name: 1,000 screenshots a week
benefits.description: A fair-use limit of 1,000 screenshots a week, with zip and bulk uploads and the highest priority in the reading queue.

benefits.name: Unlimited channels and history
benefits.description: Track as many channels as you like and see every week you have ever recorded.

benefits.name: Server-wide reports
benefits.description: Reports that combine all your channels into one view of the whole server.

benefits.name: Everything in Alliance
benefits.description: Player, trend and growth reports, clean charts, duplicate-name tools and CSV/JSON export.

benefits.name: 5,000+ trivia questions
benefits.description: The extended trivia bank from Open Trivia DB, on top of the standard and Last Z questions.

benefits.name: Cross-server trivia
benefits.description: Challenge other servers to trivia matches.
